title: A Three-Window Decomposition of Cosmological Redshift in Energy-Flow Cosmology A synthesis note: TCMB , CDDR, and S(z) consistency under one regime parameter
abstract: Synthesis note introducing a single-integral decomposition of observed cosmological redshift in Energy-Flow Cosmology using an effective entropy field Seff and a unifying regime scale aG. It links three observational windows—TCMB(z), the cosmic distance-duality relation η(z), and structural S(z) consistency—under one parameter with explicit projections (aH0 = aG/2, ac = aG/4), and recovers ΛCDM when ∇Seff → 0.
